'''2004 Marmalade Dog''' was Marmalade Dog 9, a local gaming convention at the Bernhard Center, 1903 W. Michigan Ave, Kalamazoo, Michigan, on 2–4 April 2004.<ref name="pcf-2786-40698">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40698#40698 Marmalade Dog SWCCG, April  2-4 at Kalamazoo, MI], Sithborg, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040507095933/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2786 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2786-43032">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=43032#43032 Marmalade Dog SWCCG, April  2-4 at Kalamazoo, MI], WMGG, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 March 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040507095933/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2786 Internet Archive]</ref> A player posting as Sithborg ran a weekend of ''Star Wars'' CCG events there, including an open tournament that was a World Championship qualifier with a bye to Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" /><ref name="pcf-2786-40980">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40980#40980 Marmalade Dog SWCCG, April  2-4 at Kalamazoo, MI], Sithborg, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040507095933/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2786 Internet Archive]</ref>

Convention fees were $20 for all three days, $15 for two days, $10 for Saturday and $7 for Friday or Sunday.<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" /> Pre-registration for Marmalade Dog 9 closed on 26 March 2004.<ref name="pcf-2786-43032" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Bernhard Center, 1903 W. Michigan Ave, Kalamazoo, Michigan<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" />
* '''Dates:''' 2–4 April 2004<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" />
* '''Organizer:''' Sithborg<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" />

== Schedule ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Date !! Time !! Event
|-
| Friday 2 April 2004 || 6:00 pm || [[Classic]] tournament, four rounds, $5 entry; first place won free entry to Saturday's open tournament<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" />
|-
| Saturday 3 April 2004 || 10:00 am || [[Enhanced Premiere]] Overdrive, $5 entry<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" />
|-
| Saturday 3 April 2004 || 2:30 pm || Open tournament, six rounds, $15 entry; World Championship qualifier with a bye to Day 2<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" /><ref name="pcf-2786-40980" />
|-
| Sunday 4 April 2004 || 11:30 am || [[Sealed Deck]] tournament, $5 entry<ref name="pcf-2786-40698" />
|}

On 23 February 2004 Sithborg confirmed that the open tournament was a World Championship qualifier.<ref name="pcf-2786-40980" /> A player posting as pietrang expected about 15 players, naming [[Joe Giannetti|Joe Gianetti]], his own brother, a player named Bryan and [[Chris Hall]] among the players he expected.<ref name="pcf-2786-40989">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40989#40989 Marmalade Dog SWCCG, April  2-4 at Kalamazoo, MI], pietrang, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 February 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040507095933/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=2786 Internet Archive]</ref>
